## Scene edits import cold assets on demand

Headless Godot never runs the importer, so on a project with no `.godot/imported`, or one where you just dropped a new texture, `ResourceLoader.load` returns null for a file that is plainly on disk. The visible symptom was `load_sprite` failing with "Failed to load texture" and a hint to open the editor once. The silent one was worse: a scene that referenced an unimported asset loaded with the property set to null, no error anywhere, and the auto-save every mutation tool performs wrote the scene back without the reference.

Every scene mutation now probes the scene's dependencies before `load()`. An asset that exists on disk but was never imported triggers a headless `--import` of the project and one retry of the operation, transparently, so the first `add_node` on a fresh checkout succeeds and takes a few seconds longer instead of failing or stripping a texture. `load_sprite` and `res://` strings assigned to Object-typed properties run the same check on the asset they are about to load, so a texture you added a minute ago works on the first call. `batch_scene_operations` probes every scene and every first-time asset reference in the batch before applying anything, since an import discovered mid-batch would replay the operations that had already saved.

A reference to a file that is not on disk at all is refused rather than tolerated, because there is no way to carry a null reference through pack and save without losing it. The error names the paths and the scene file is left untouched, which is the same guard the editor's "Dependencies Broken" dialog provides. Godot's `--import` exits 0 even when individual assets fail, so the server reads the `Error importing` lines on stderr and reports them by file; a corrupt PNG anywhere in the project now surfaces as an import error instead of being skipped. A live runtime session on the same project blocks the import, since it would write `.godot/` under a running game.

Thanks to [@mcanevet](https://github.com/mcanevet) for the diagnosis, the integration tests that pin it, and the batch pre-pass. The mechanism, the two shapes `get_dependencies` returns, and the approaches that did not work are written up in the "Cold Asset Import" section of `docs/architecture.md`.
